scripts.dev: dotenv -e .env -- concurrently -k -n API,WEB -c blue,green "npm run start:dev -w @inmobiliaria/api" "npm run dev -w @inmobiliaria/web"
scripts.build: npm run db:generate && npm run build -w @inmobiliaria/api && npm run build -w @inmobiliaria/web
scripts.test:regressions: node --import tsx --test --test-concurrency=1 apps/web/lib/api.test.ts apps/web/lib/public-data.test.ts apps/web/lib/catalog-filters.test.mjs scripts/format-date.test.mjs scripts/payment-config-policy.test.mjs apps/api/src/payments/payment-config.test.ts
scripts.infra:up: docker compose up -d postgres minio minio-init
